B Series- Workflow, Bible, Risk Template, SOPs, Checklists, Forms.pdf

Open the project only after scope, roles, authority, communication rhythm and customer SPOC are understood. Record the facts in the existing project, SOR, document-control and gate records; do not create a parallel tracker.
Approved commercial handover/intake, identifiable customer and project scope, nominated internal owner, and controlled project workspace.
Hold or reject when scope assumptions remain open, authority is resisted, the customer expects uncontrolled 24x7 updates, or roles and reporting channels are not accepted.
Signed project charter, acknowledged roles and authority, accepted reporting rhythm, nominated customer SPOC, controlled document register, and recorded B1 GO/HOLD/NO-GO decision.
B Series- Workflow, Bible, Risk Template, SOPs, Checklists, Forms.pdf

Convert customer requirements into controlled SOR points and link each point to the existing BOP/component, design, mould-planning, risk, trial and evidence records. Assign every SOR point to all stages where it must be verified; retain the customer source and revision as provenance.
Customer SOR or approved Hongyi SOR structure, identifiable source revision, product/BOP context, assumptions list, and responsible reviewer.
Do not freeze or release a commitment when a requirement is ambiguous, untraceable, commercially excluded, unsupported by evidence, or assigned to no verification stage.
SOR baseline and BOP relationship frozen, every requirement distributed to applicable lifecycle gates, open assumptions explicitly held, and subsequent changes routed only through ECN/change control.
B Series- Workflow, Bible, Risk Template, SOPs, Checklists, Forms.pdf

Review product data, manufacturability, interfaces, critical requirements, tolerances and unresolved design challenges with the responsible functions. Capture decisions and evidence in the existing design review/challenge records before sign-off.
Current customer data, controlled SOR/BOP baseline, review participants, design challenge/risk visibility, and supplier feasibility inputs where applicable.

Hold when product data is incomplete, feasibility is doubtful, acceptance criteria are unclear, customer behaviour creates execution risk, or a decision is being treated as final without written authority.
Approved design review decision, closed or formally accepted challenges, controlled revision, responsibility boundaries, and B2 GO/HOLD/NO-GO evidence.
B Series- Workflow, Bible, Risk Template, SOPs, Checklists, Forms.pdf

Use the existing mould planning form to derive tool concept, operations, steel, timing, trials and critical risks from the controlled SOR/BOP and design decisions. Link—not copy—existing risk and design-challenge entries.
Controlled SOR/BOP, available product data, design review status, known risks/challenges, target tool life and programme timing assumptions.
Do not present an estimate as a guarantee or authorize tooling while product inputs, tool concept, steel intent, critical assumptions or risk ownership remain unclear.
Approved mould planning revision, linked risks/challenges, explicit assumptions and exclusions, stage verification plan, and authorized next-gate decision.
B Series- Workflow, Bible, Risk Template, SOPs, Checklists, Forms.pdf

Evaluate the toolmaker against technical capability, capacity, quality discipline, communication, commercial clarity and behaviour. Record comparable evidence and the approved selection in the existing supplier/toolmaker records.
Defined RFQ scope, controlled technical inputs, comparable supplier quotations, qualification evidence, and named selection authority.
Do not issue PO or release advance when capability is doubtful, documents are incomplete, quotation scope is ambiguous, behaviour is unacceptable, or the decision lacks approval.
Signed/stamped final quotation, approved selection rationale, frozen scope/inclusions/exclusions, supplier responsibilities, commercial approval and recorded B2 decision.
B Series- Workflow, Bible, Risk Template, SOPs, Checklists, Forms.pdf

Validate DFM, Moldflow assumptions, tool concept, steel intent, responsibility lock and known risks against the frozen product requirements. Record the decision in the existing pre-tooling and gate controls before any steel cut.
B2 approval, frozen product/design inputs, supplier commitment, reviewed DFM/Moldflow/tool concept, steel proposal, and visible residual risks.
No steel GO for mismatched simulation assumptions, unstable tool concept, unresolved critical risk, guarantee language, unclear responsibility, or pressure for speed over clarity.
Approved engineering direction with known risks, frozen tool concept and steel intent, responsibility lock, supplier acknowledgement, and formal B3 Steel GO/HOLD/NO-GO evidence.
B Series- Workflow, Bible, Risk Template, SOPs, Checklists, Forms.pdf

Run tooling through the existing manufacturing plan and reporting records. Track planned versus actual operations, steel evidence, deviations, risk, decisions and approved changes; use ECN only for post-freeze customer changes with both customer and supplier commercial impact.
Formal Steel GO, frozen controlled inputs, approved manufacturing plan, responsible supplier/team, reporting cadence, and accepted change route.

Escalate unauthorized steel/process/design changes, missing traceability, concealed deviation, unsupported progress claims, overdue critical operations, or any ECN work without commercial authorization.
Manufacturing operations evidenced, deviations closed or accepted, changes traceable, trial readiness confirmed, controlled reports uploaded, and B4 GO/HOLD/NO-GO decision recorded.
B Series- Workflow, Bible, Risk Template, SOPs, Checklists, Forms.pdf

Plan each trial against the SOR verification map and use the existing part visual, assembly and dimensional inspection records. Preserve machine/material/process conditions, sample identity, observations, measurements and stakeholder decisions.
Trial-ready tool, approved trial plan, correct machine/material/process window, inspection plan, calibrated measurement route, and applicable SOR points.
Do not accept a trial with substituted conditions, unidentified samples, incomplete inspection, missing requirement traceability, verbal-only approval, or concealed nonconformity.
Controlled trial report, visual/assembly/dimensional evidence, SOR point results, accepted defects/deviations, signed decision and next trial/final-validation route.
B Series- Workflow, Bible, Risk Template, SOPs, Checklists, Forms.pdf

Convert every failed trial observation into an owned corrective action linked to the defect, root cause, approved correction and next verification. Separate supplier correction from customer-requested post-freeze ECN work and its commercials.
Controlled failed/conditional trial evidence, defect classification, requirement link, responsible owner, target date, and commercial/change classification.
No re-trial on symptom-only action, unapproved design/tool change, missing root cause, unclear cost ownership, or incomplete previous-trial evidence.
Root cause and corrective action approved, change/ECN authority recorded where needed, action evidence complete, re-trial conditions frozen, and re-verification results linked.
B Series- Workflow, Bible, Risk Template, SOPs, Checklists, Forms.pdf

Confirm that the final controlled trial satisfies the applicable SOR, inspection and accepted-deviation criteria. Freeze the evidence and obtain formal buy-off; installation support is separate and no product warranty is implied.
Completed required trials, closed corrective actions, final inspection evidence, controlled sample, accepted commercial/change status, and named approval authority.
No buy-off with open critical defects, incomplete SOR verification, conditional or verbal signatures, uncontrolled documents, unclear liability, or unresolved commercial exposure.
Formal Master Buy-Off/NO-GO decision, frozen documents, recorded liability transfer, no open unauthorized work, and B6/exit route defined.
B Series- Workflow, Bible, Risk Template, SOPs, Checklists, Forms.pdf
Authorize dispatch only after buy-off, preservation/packing, export documents, Incoterm, insurance and custody/risk transfer are controlled in the existing dispatch and commercial records.
B5 buy-off, dispatch-ready tool, approved packing/preservation, shipment plan, document pack, Incoterm, risk-transfer point and responsible parties.
No physical movement when documents, packing, Incoterm, insurance, payment/commercial position, custody or authority are ambiguous.
Shipment authority decision, approved dispatch evidence, frozen Incoterm and risk-transfer point, complete export/packing records, and executed or formally blocked shipment.
B Series- Workflow, Bible, Risk Template, SOPs, Checklists, Forms.pdf

Track the approved shipment through custody transfer and customer-site receipt using the existing logistics records. Preserve milestone evidence and transfer only the authorized handover facts into site-run governance.
B6 shipment GO, carrier/route details, controlled shipping pack, Incoterm/risk point, insurance responsibility, consignee and site readiness contact.
Escalate route/custody deviation, damage, missing document, unconfirmed delivery, customs/commercial ambiguity, or any attempt to carry unresolved B6 liability silently into B7.
Delivery and condition evidence, custody/risk transition recorded, exceptions resolved or escalated, customer/site handover acknowledged, and B7 entry authorized.
B Series- Workflow, Bible, Risk Template, SOPs, Checklists, Forms.pdf

Control receipt, installation support, site trial, stabilisation and sign-off through the existing site/closure evidence. Close the project once contracted support and acceptance are complete; later change, paid support or ECN must start through its proper route.
B6 closed, tool received with condition evidence, site readiness, agreed installation-support boundary, trial conditions, responsible customer SPOC and open-issue visibility.
Do not close on verbal acceptance, partial communication, open critical site issue, undocumented damage/deviation, unclear support boundary, or unapproved additional work.
Site run and stabilisation evidence, customer acceptance/sign-off, issue closure status, supplier/customer/internal notification, responsibility boundary and B7 closure decision.
B Series- Workflow, Bible, Risk Template, SOPs, Checklists, Forms.pdf

After operational closure, extract technical, commercial, governance, customer and supplier learning into the controlled knowledge/closure records. Archive authority assets and permissions; B8 is intelligence capture, not ongoing support or warranty.
B7 formally closed, final evidence frozen, financial/change status available, learning contributors identified, and authority/brand-consent status reviewable.

Do not use raw customer/supplier information for marketing, treat B8 as operational follow-up, imply warranty, expose restricted learning, or archive an authority asset without consent and access control.

Lessons and performance truth captured, profitability/ECN learning recorded, supplier/customer signals classified, authority and testimonial permissions locked, system improvements assigned, archive/access controls completed.
